open_points.subject: Overall progress denominator and availability
open_points.text: A9 excludes “a section without a progress record” from both sums and makes progress unavailable when that denominator is 0, while INV-041 says it is unavailable “when no planned work cost exists”; State 1 likewise says it is unavailable “when total planned work is zero.”
open_points.question: When the active version has positive planned work but no recorded progress for any positive-work section, is overall progress unavailable or an available 0%?
options: Exclude unrecorded sections, giving a zero denominator and unavailable progress.
Include their planned work in the denominator and their completed contribution as zero, giving 0%.
Refuse the projection because the normative rule and invariant cannot both hold.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the changed A9 formula: exclude unrecorded sections and return unavailable.

witness.initial: The active budget has one section with work_planned = EUR 100.00 and no SectionProgress record.
events: A viewer requests the project progress view.
outcomes: A9 excludes the section from both sums, so the denominator is 0 and overall_progress_percent is unavailable.
INV-041 and the State 1 derived-view rule see EUR 100.00 of planned work, so the stated unavailability condition is false; using M32's zero completed-work contribution yields an available 0.00%.
witness.observer: The viewer sees either unavailable progress or 0.00%.

open_points.subject: Exact deployed dependency pins
open_points.text: “the pinned versions are those of that file” replaces the four exact version values, but the reviewed texts do not contain the referenced file’s contents.
open_points.question: Which exact versions of fastapi, pydantic, argon2-cffi and uvicorn must later states and the deployment use?
options: Retain the formerly explicit pins: fastapi==0.135.1, pydantic==2.12.5, argon2-cffi==25.1.0 and uvicorn==0.42.0.
Use whatever versions happen to be in the referenced Factory file when implementation begins.
Choose new exact versions through an implementation-time Factory change.
open_points.default_guess: Retain the formerly explicit pins until an accepted Factory change supplies different exact values.

witness.initial: Two implementations receive these accepted texts alone; neither has the referenced Factory requirements file.
events: Each implementer creates the deployment requirements required by A32.
One copies the formerly explicit versions visible in the change history; the other selects different current exact versions while preserving the four package names and == pins.
outcomes: The deployments run different framework, validation, hashing and server versions while each claims conformance to the text’s unnamed file contents.
Their dependency behavior, vulnerability results and potentially argon2 defaults differ.
witness.observer: Deploy operators and portal users can observe different runtime behavior or deploy acceptance.
